risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and clearly attributes the deterioration from $728.6 million of net income to a $33.3 million net loss, primarily due to lower refining profitability and higher operating costs. Risk exposure is elevated from commodity volatility, geopolitical disruptions, inflationary pressures, and financing costs, although management states that inflation was not material in 2024. Extensive non-GAAP measures, broad causal qualifiers, and cross-references add interpretive complexity.
